SERVICE_HEADLINE: Four decades on the same corner
TAGLINE: A family owned, AAA Approved shop that has been repairing cars in Reseda since 1981. Full service for foreign and domestic vehicles.
ADDRESS: 18401 Vanowen St, Ste S, Reseda, CA 91335
SERVICES_INTRO: A full service shop: the same people handle the diagnosis, the repair and the conversation about what it costs.
SERVICE_1_BODY: Foreign and domestic, engine to exhaust, on cars that are driven every day.
SERVICE_2_BODY: Finding the actual fault before anything is replaced, so you pay for the repair and not the search.
SERVICE_3_BODY: Servicing at factory intervals to keep the car healthy and the warranty intact.
WHY_INTRO: There are other shops within a few minutes of here. This is what a customer actually notices.
WHY_1_BODY: The quote comes before the work, and nothing gets done without you agreeing to it.
WHY_2_BODY: A person picks up during opening hours, and a missed call gets returned the same day.
WHY_3_BODY: Whatever came off the car is there to look at if you want to see it.
CONTACT_INTRO: Call for anything urgent. For a quote or a booking the form reaches the desk directly.
ABOUT_BODY: Vince's has been on Vanowen Street since 1981, veteran owned and operated. It is an AAA Approved Auto Repair facility with ASE Master Technician certification, an official Lamp and Brake Adjusting Station, and a State of California licensed smog check inspection and repair station.
